text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Former state president Canaan Banana appeared before a regional court on Monday where he was indicted to the High Court for trial next month on 11 charges of sexual assault.

- Zimbabwe's health delivery system has deteriorated considerably because doctors and nurses are leaving government services in large numbers owing mainly to a 40 percent decline in per capita expenditure on health since the launch of economic reforms in 1991.

- A High Court judge says the number of community service placements is declining steadily and has urged magistrates to place deserving convicts on the scheme, saying some people are being jailed unnecessarily.
